description: This file defines the CommentTypeForm class, a Drupal form handler for editing comment type entities, including form construction, validation, and saving logic.

classes.name: CommentTypeForm
classes.description: A form handler class for editing comment type entities in Drupal, extending EntityForm and managing form display and submission.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with services from the container.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with entity type manager, logger, and comment manager services.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the comment type edit form, including fields for label, ID, description, target entity type, and language settings.
